blocks.text: The Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) celebrated its 175th anniversary with its valued Chinese-Filipino clients through this year’s Mid-Autumn Festival, honoring the generations of relationships, shared values, and successes that have shaped its journey with the community. Guided by the theme “Beneath the Same Moon, Along the Same River,” the celebration reflected the spirit of the Mid-Autumn Festival—the full moon symbolizing togetherness, and the river representing continuity as traditions, values, and relationships are passed from one generation to the next.
